snippet.title: Why Do Your Fingers Wrinkle in Water? #HumanBody
snippet.description:
Wrinkled fingertips start with a signal from your nervous system. One experiment found that people with wrinkled fingers moved wet marbles faster. Other experiments found no advantage. The mechanism is clearer than the reason.

'Thinking Music' by Kevin MacLeod — https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/index.html?isrc=USUAN1600060. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Excerpt trimmed, EQ'd, faded and mixed under narration.
